def cellmap(frame):
    lines = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    bands_r = [(12,15),(18,21),(24,27),(30,33),(36,39),(42,45),(48,51)]
    bands_c = [(11,14),(17,20),(23,26),(29,32),(35,38),(41,44),(47,50)]
    out = {}
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(bands_r):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(bands_c):
            block = [lines[r][c0:c1+1] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
            # skip cells outside board (check white surroundings)
            joined = ''.join(block)
            out[(ri,ci)] = joined
    return out

before = cellmap(previous_frame)
after = cellmap(current_frame)
diffs = [k for k in before if before[k]!=after[k]]
print('changed cells', diffs)
for k in diffs:
    print(k, 'BEFORE', before[k], 'AFTER', after[k])
